text:
gina (AP): Uploaded NorthArc Labs invoice NAL-5533.pdf - total $14,560 - no discrete PO field detected, OCR found 'PO: 0996' in body but low confidence. Attached.
accounts-bot: Invoice received: NAL-5533.pdf (vendor id NA-221) - parsed amount $14,560.00 - PO detection: none (OCR: "PO:0996" -> LOW_CONF).
omar (Finance Ops): @kelly can procurement search for NA-221 PO history? Looks like model profiling services.
kelly (Procurement): Looking now. Vendor NA-221 has PO-0996 on file but it's assigned to Redwood-APAC (GL 5470) and closed. We have PO-1577 under Redwood-US but that's for consulting, different SOW.
gina (AP): Invoice billed to Redwood-US / GL 5403 in header. Mismatch prevents auto-apply.
rajesh (ML Eng): NorthArc did one-off dataset curation for the US search team (ticket SEARCH-901). We paid them previously under PO-1577 for a separate engagement. This invoice is for dataset labeling under SOW NAL-SOW-54.
marta (Eng Manager): Confirm it's for US search deliverables. I can approve, but Procurement prefers PO match or intercompany journal.
kelly (Procurement): Two options: re-open PO-0996 as cross-entity or process as Non-PO Payment Request (NPR). Intercompany journals take ~4 business days. Do we need to pay before due (due 2026-03-25)?
omar (Finance Ops): If not urgent, intercompany would be cleaner. If vendor requires payment on Net 15, we can do NPR with manager approval and reconcile later. Also flag: invoice shows EU VAT €1,120 (converted by OCR), vendor master shows VAT registered in Ireland. Paying from US means VAT not reclaimable.
vendor-bot: Vendor master NA-221 - NorthArc Labs Ltd - Tax ID NA-IE-452 - Default entity Redwood-EU. Default remit: EUR IBAN.
gina (AP): Vendor bank provided EUR IBAN only. Are we allowed to wire EUR from US ledger? That may involve FX and treasury approval.
rajesh (ML Eng): We have an email agreement from vendor to accept USD ACH for US work. I'll attach the thread.
marta (Eng Manager): Please attach and include ticket SEARCH-901 in the payment note. I approve payment from US ledger pending procurement sign-off on remit. Approver: marta (Eng Manager).
kelly (Procurement): Please attach the ACH confirmation. If ACH exists, procurement can approve alternate remit and we can create NPR-9121. Also open a ticket PROC-4592 to correct vendor default remit and PO assignment.
omar (Finance Ops): Creating NPR now. NPR-9121 created and routed to marta, procurement, and AP. Link: https://redwood/payments/NPR-9121
accounts-bot: NPR-9121 status: pending approval from marta.
accounts-bot: marta approved NPR-9121 - comment: "Charge SEARCH-901 (US) - expedite to meet vendor Net15."
gina (AP): Scheduling payment. Note: flag set "subject-to-tax-review" because vendor is foreign and payment instrument is alternate.
kelly (Procurement): PROC-4592 created to update vendor default remit to include USD and to review PO-0996 entity ownership. ETA 3 business days.
vendor-bot: Payment scheduled: NPR-9121 - wire scheduled 2026-03-19 - REF NA-EUR-7782.
gina (AP): Wire executed, remittance received. Marking thread resolved.
omar (Finance Ops): Follow up: procurement please confirm intercompany or journal once PROC-4592 closed. We should avoid repeated NPR for the same vendor.
kelly (Procurement): Will reconcile. Adding note to PO-0996 to prevent autoplace mismatch.
rajesh (ML Eng): Thanks, lesson learned: include project code SEARCH-901 on invoices and SOW references.
accounts-bot: Thread closed.
